items.title: Stale metadata after crash
items.body: After a crash, the metadata for the last checkpoint stays stale until the next mount. Reproduced on kernel 6.6.

items.title: Add zone GC accounting docs
items.body:
This documents how zone GC accounting works end to end: the free-segment counter, the victim selection heuristic, the cost-benefit formula used to pick segments, how the checkpoint records the running total, how it interacts with the small-write buffer, why the background thread throttles itself under memory pressure, and what happens when GC falls behind the foreground write rate long enough that writes have to block on it directly instead of running purely in the background, which is the condition operators actually care about in practice.

| mode | trigger | blocks writes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| background | idle time | no |
| foreground | low free space | yes |
| urgent | critical | yes |
